comparison_reference_solver: same final FM_STANDARD checkpoint with Heun sampling; Euler reference is reported separately

fixed_comparisons.question: complete Brownian state diffusion method with corresponding FP target

paired_difference_definition: comparison model metric minus that comparison's reference model metric at the same training seed; FM_STANDARD references use Heun
interval_method: two-sided 95% Student t interval over training seeds; incomplete seed groups explicitly labeled partial
hypothesis_test: two-sided paired Student t test; descriptive and assumption-dependent with five seeds
multiple_comparison_method: Holm correction within each dataset and metric over seven fixed comparisons (three research contrasts and four model-versus-standard-Heun contrasts); raw intervals and adjusted p values remain separate
sampling_replication: independent ensembles retained inside each checkpoint; interacting particles/projections/metric pairs are not independent training seeds
missing_policy: Keep all 50 manifest rows. Never impute failed/blocked runs or drop them from the formal denominator. Partial mean/interval states the available n of 5 and is not a final five-seed comparison.
interpretation_limits: SEQ_IID assesses independent sequence generation only; it does not establish long-memory or temporal-dependency advantages. No predetermined model winner.
